topic: The Prokaryotic Cell: Envelope, Mesosome and Ribosomes
title: What Wraps a Bacterium? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A parcel in bubble wrap, a coconut with husk and shell, and bacteria on a lab slide that stain purple or pink. Diya asks: what wraps a bacterium, and why do bacteria stain differently?

You will meet the three layered cell envelope (glycocalyx, cell wall, plasma membrane), zoom from a whole bacterium to its envelope and a 70S ribosome, and build the layers step by step with the slime layer, capsule and Gram stain. Then the mesosome and its jobs, the flagellum (filament, hook, basal body), pili and fimbriae, polysomes and inclusion bodies, a pause and think check, a worked example, the exam trap about 50S plus 30S, an original NEET pattern question and a recap card.

This is Episode 62 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:
